articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Belgium equalize late against Senegal to send it to extra time
articles.description: We have three matches for you on Wednesday as the round-of-32 action at the 2026 World Cup continues.

articles.headline: 2026 World Cup Golden Boot tracker: Will Messi, Mbappe, or other score most goals?
articles.description: We're into the round of 32 at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, and the race for the Golden Boot -- given to the tournament's top goal scorer -- is red-hot.

articles.headline: Kane rescues England from enormous upset
articles.description: England advance to the round of 16 after a late Harry Kane double saves a huge potential DR Congo upset.

articles.headline: Harry Kane: I had my World Cup 'hero moment' with brace vs. Congo DR
articles.description: Harry Kane revelled in having his "hero moment" as he saved England from a humiliating World Cup exit to Congo DR.

articles.headline: Declan Rice not keen on England World Cup right-back role: 'Hardest 12 minutes of the game'
articles.description: Declan Rice hopes he won't have to fill in at right-back again after playing the "hardest 12 minutes" of England's 2-1 win over Congo DR in the position.

articles.headline: Harry Kane, Kylian Mbappé, Lionel Messi, Erling Haaland are 'sharks' who 'smell blood' at World Cup - Thomas Tuchel
articles.description: Thomas Tuchel has described Harry Kane, Kylian Mbappé, Lionel Messi and Erling Haaland as "sharks" after their goalscoring feats at the 2026 World Cup.
